services.name: Field trips
services.desc: TITLE I RESOURCES The museum’s Incentive Grant Program encourages Pre-K through 12th grade visits to The Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art by underwriting school workshop fees and providing a stipend to offset trip-related expenses for schoolwide, Title I schools in Missouri and Kansas. Eligibility and Guidelines If your school has been classified as a schoolwide, Title I school in the Kansas City metropolitan area, your school is eligible to participate in the museum’s Incentive Grant Program. If you believe your school has been left off the list in error, please contact incentive@nelson-atkins.org.
